Hello, I hope this is the correct place for this. If not, please point me in the right direction! I have been wanting to get started in the music business but I just don't know where to begin. I would like to form a group of maybe 4-5 girls and I'm interested in singing and dancing. I have found one other person so far that can do both and is interested. What steps should we take from here? Thanks in advance!

You've got to find other like minded people who want to do the same thing as you. If you all have similar tastes in music that is a HUGE plus, but if the styles of music are not similar it might not work, or yet it still could if everyone, and I mean everyone is committed to doing it.

I'm, really, primarily a singer myself but in a band situation if all you do is sing sometimes you are looked at as the prima Donna that doesn't really carry their weight like the rest of the band members. I also am a decent guitar player but there are people who are way better than me.

As for writing songs? You need to invest some time into learning how to play something so that you can get your idea of the song out for others to hear it. If you have bandmates who write songs you can bounce ideas off of each other to come up with something that sounds good. For originally in your songs, write about things that you know about. You! Your experiences! Your life! And if you are really daring and really want to be real you could write about your inner world of the things that you think that nobody knows about. Those are the most honest and best songs that I've ever written. But because you can use lyrical metaphors and beautiful words and rhymes, that inner world of yours is still yours alone unless you fully spell out what it means to people.

I'm sure there are other things that the group can give you some more ideas on, but those are my initial thoughts for you.
